items.excerpt: On 24 December 2025 at 9:00 a.m., at the Ratchadamnoen Room, Royal Princess Larn Luang Hotel, Bangkok, Professor Emeritus Dr. Suraphon Itsarakraisin, M.D., President of the Royal Society of Thailand, opened the academic forum "Fellows of the Royal Society, Revered Persons, Scholars of the Land, No. 14" and the brainstorming forum on the Royal Society of Thailand 5-Year Strategy, No. 3, on the occasion of the 100th anniversary of the Royal Society of Thailand. Dr. Supharoek Phuphongsak, Secretary-General of the Royal Society, delivered the report. A total of 147 participants attended, including Fellows, Associate Fellows, executives and staff of the Office of the Royal Society, and speakers who are descendants and students of the revered Fellows
